constraints.source: I sleep from 11:30pm to 7:30am on weeknights
constraints.paraphrase: Sleep 11:30pm to 7:30am on Sunday through Thursday nights.

constraints.source: on weekends I stay up till 2 and sleep in till 10
constraints.paraphrase: Sleep 2:00am to 10:00am on Friday and Saturday nights.
